# SkyCut: full fact sheet

> SkyCut is an AI video editor for Mac. You edit on a native multitrack timeline, or connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex and direct the edit in your own words. It runs on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15 or later and is made by Sky Lu as part of the Sky Studio product family.

This file is generated from the same content as https://skycut.app. Short version: https://skycut.app/llms.txt

## Key facts

- Platform: Mac only. Apple silicon (arm64) and macOS 15 or later. There is no Intel Mac version and no Windows version.
- Price: the Free plan costs $0 and has no time limit. Pro costs $19 per month or $149 per year in USD (¥129 or ¥999 in CNY on the Chinese site). Prices exclude tax.
- Free includes the full manual editor, subtitles, screen recording and the file tools. Videos exported on Free carry a Sky Studio watermark.
- Pro adds AI editing through MCP, exports without the watermark, and lets AI call cloud models. New accounts get 7 days of Pro.
- AI editing: SkyCut includes a local MCP server with built-in setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex. You bring your own AI client. The AI works on the real timeline, where you can inspect, change or undo what it did.
- Cloud generation (images, video, music, narration, sound effects, lip sync, upscaling) uses Sky Studio credits, which are bought separately. Yearly Pro includes 1,000 Sky Studio credits for each paid year; monthly Pro includes none.
- Download: https://skylu.ai/download/skycut
- Buy Pro: https://skystudioai.com/app/skycut/pro (sign in to Sky Studio first)
- Contact: support@skycut.app

## Questions and answers

### What is SkyCut?

SkyCut is an AI video editor for Mac. You edit on a native multitrack timeline, or connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex and direct the edit in your own words. It runs on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15 or later and is made by Sky Lu as part of the Sky Studio product family.

### Which Mac do I need?

An Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later. Automatic transcription uses Apple speech recognition and needs macOS 26. Intel Mac and Windows versions are not available.

### Is SkyCut free?

Yes. The Free plan has no time limit and includes the full manual editor; exported videos carry a Sky Studio watermark. Pro ($19 per month or $149 per year) removes the watermark and adds AI editing.

### How does AI editing work?

SkyCut includes a local MCP server. In Settings, Connect AI sets up Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex. You describe the edit in the AI client, and the AI makes the changes on the SkyCut timeline, where you can inspect, refine or undo them. AI editing needs Pro. A regular ChatGPT web chat cannot connect to the local MCP server.

### Do I need a Sky Studio account?

Only for Pro and for cloud generation. SkyCut Pro is tied to a Sky Studio account (one person, up to 2 Macs), and cloud models are paid for with Sky Studio credits. Manual editing on Free needs no account.

### Does my footage stay on my Mac?

Editing and project files are local. A connected AI client and any cloud generation you ask for receive the content needed for that request.

### Who makes SkyCut?

Sky Lu, the founder of Sky Studio. SkyCut is part of the Sky Studio product family.

## Plans and terms

- Free: $0, no time limit.
- Pro monthly: $19 per month (¥129 on the Chinese site). No credits included.
- Pro yearly: $149 per year (¥999 on the Chinese site). Includes 1,000 Sky Studio credits for each paid year.
- Pro is for one person on up to 2 Macs.
- Prices exclude tax; local taxes are added at checkout.
- Auto renewal can be cancelled at any time, and Pro stays active through the paid period.
- Payments are nonrefundable except where required by law.
- Image, video and voice generation use Sky Studio credits purchased separately.

### Local models

Local processing uses no Sky Studio credits. Calling these tools through AI requires Pro. The built-in voices cover Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi.

| Apple Translation | Translate subtitles on this Mac Requires macOS 15 and supported downloaded languages | In the app, No credits used | In the app or via AI, No credits used |
| Apple Vision | Identify subjects and recognize text in footage | Requires Pro | Via AI, No credits used |
| SkyCut shot detection | Find shot boundaries using local picture analysis | Requires Pro | Via AI, No credits used |
| Built-in multilingual voices | 8 preset characters for Chinese and English Download the local voice pack once Languages below | Requires Pro | Via AI, No credits used |
| Built-in sound effect synth | 16 local presets for editing sounds | Requires Pro | Via AI, No credits used |

### Cloud models

Cloud models use Sky Studio credits. On Pro the AI calls them for you; video upscaling can also be used directly in the app on Free. The catalog changes, and the app shows the current list.

- Image generation: Seedream 5.0 Flash, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana 2 Lite, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Seedream 5.0 Pro
- Image camera angle: Qwen Angles
- Image upscale: Image Upscale
- Image background removal: Ideogram Remove Background
- Video generation: Minimax H3, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Veo 3.1 Fast, Seedance 2.0 Pro, Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0 Text to Video, Wan 3.0 Image to Video, Wan 3.0 Reference to Video
- Lip sync: HeyGen v3 Lipsync Speed, HeyGen v3 Lipsync Precision, MiniMax H3 Max Lip Sync (Image to Video)
- Music generation: Lyria 3 Pro
- Narration generation: Eleven v4 narration
- Sound effect generation: Sonilo sound effects
- Voice cloning: Zonos 2 voice clone
- Video upscaling: Topaz Starlight, ByteDance Upscaler Pro

## Getting started

1. Install SkyCut: Download the Mac release, open the disk image and move SkyCut to Applications. You need an Apple silicon Mac and macOS 15 or later.
2. Bring in your footage: Create a project and import your clips. Arrange video, sound and subtitles on the timeline.
3. Connect your AI: In a build with Sky Studio settings, create a Key at Sky Studio and add it in SkyCut. Open Settings → Connect AI and choose Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex. AI access depends on your entitlement.
4. Review and export: Play it back, refine the details and export. The export panel tells you if a watermark applies. Cloud generation is billed separately in Sky Studio credits.

Supported AI clients: Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Codex have built-in setup. Other clients need local stdio MCP support. A regular ChatGPT web chat cannot connect directly to the local SkyCut MCP server.

## Privacy

- Email updates: When you sign up, we collect your email address, your three choices (SkyCut newsletter, Intel Mac availability and Windows availability), your language, and signup and update times. We store these in a Google spreadsheet belonging to Sky Studio, with Google acting as our data processor. We use them only to send the types of notifications you select.
- Retention and unsubscribe: We keep your signup data until you unsubscribe or request deletion. To unsubscribe or have your data deleted, email support@skycut.app.
- Website preferences: We store your language and animation preference in your browser. We do not add advertising trackers. Hosting and email providers may process technical information needed to deliver their services.
- Film and downloads: Playing the demo loads video from downloads.skylu.ai. Downloading the Mac app takes you to the existing Sky Lu download service.
- The Mac app: This page describes the website. Connected AI tools and Sky Studio services have their own data handling. Your editing project stays on your Mac; content used in a cloud request can be sent to the service you choose.
